decisions.reason: Colloid cyst case report restating endodermal vs tela-choroidea neuroepithelial origin; paraphysis not mentioned in full text, no histogenesis data.
Zebrafish ependymal ciliated cell types and CSF flow; tela choroidea/choroid plexus generic, no paraphysis/dorsal sac link.
Xenopus Cajal-Retzius/cortical hem markers; hem and septum domains, never relates to the paraphysis/midline roof.
Journal editorial that only cites the title of Kunkel 1915 (paraphysis and pineal region of garter snakes); no data or account of the paraphysis itself.
Axolotl MRI/histology atlas; paraphysis not labelled or mentioned per full-text check.
Mammalian cortical hem/choroid plexus/CR cell review; generic hem patterning, no link to paraphysis territory.
Turkey pineal development; pineal evagination only, no paraphysis (absent in birds).
Review of transitory/vestigial human brain structures; full abstract lists lamina terminalis remnants, suprapineal recess etc. but never names the paraphysis.
First-trimester 3D ultrasound normative data on third ventricle, commissural plate and cavum veli interpositi; imaging, does not locate or analyse the paraphysis.
Familial colloid cyst registry/systematic review (genetic predisposition); no histogenesis or paraphyseal data.
Hindbrain roof plate/choroid plexus (Lmx1a) and His; hindbrain only, not telencephalic roof.
Trisomy 9p hydrocephalus case with choroid plexus hyperplasia; colloid cyst incidental, no origin data.
Medial pallium subdomains (dentate/CA homologues) in anuran and turtle; pallial, not midline roof.

Micro-CT/dissection/radiographic ventricular casts of dogfish, bullfrog and iguana with the paraphysis (pa), dorsal sac and velum transversum labelled in figures; paraphysis not sole focus but comparative gross-anatomy data (borderline A/B).
General review of choroid plexus specification and function; hindbrain and telencephalic, no paraphysis relation.

Comparative review of brain ventricular system development; excerpt (zebrafish CVOs, choroid plexus) never names paraphysis/dorsal sac and no PMID for abstract; full-text search for 'paraphysis'/'dorsal sac' would resolve.
Survey of familial colloid cysts (genetic inheritance); no histogenesis or paraphyseal origin data.
Wnt/beta-catenin control of choroid plexus epithelial fate (hem-derived); generic ChP molecular study, no paraphysis link.
Systematic review of intracranial ependymal cysts with GFAP classification; parenchymal ependymal cysts, no colloid-cyst or paraphyseal origin discussion in abstract.
Histopathological series of 507 CNS epithelial cysts (colloid most frequent); diagnosis by location/lining, no histogenesis or paraphysis data in full abstract.
Teleost pineal anatomy/histology; dorsal sac mentioned only as seat of pineal vesicle.

Histological reinterpretation of the paraphysis cerebri in axolotl larvae: AEP and PEP evaginations proposed homologous to paraphysis and dorsal sac; principal paraphysis paper (terminology, ontogeny, location in diencephalic roof).
Zebrafish telencephalon transgene atlas; tela choroidea expansion mentioned but no paraphysis, dorsal sac or velum transversum (full-text checked by finder).
Colloid cyst case with hyphal-like structures; standard histology only, no paraphyseal origin discussion.
Chick pineal embryonic histomorphometry; no paraphysis.
Fetal suprapineal pseudocyst in spina bifida: redundant tela choroidea/arachnoid posterior to the paraphyseal territory, no paraphysis relation.

Colloid cyst case plus review explicitly stating origin from neuroectodermal paraphysis cerebri and its challenge by immunohistochemistry favouring endodermal origin; brief but explicit evaluation of paraphyseal hypothesis.
Colloid cyst hydrocephalus case asserting endodermal origin; no paraphysis or histogenesis data.
Cureus colloid cyst case; origin paragraph alludes to diencephalic-roof pouch and lower-vertebrate remnant but never names the paraphysis; second-hand, imprecise.
Systematic review of symptomatic choroid plexus cysts; no paraphysis or colloid-cyst origin analysis.
Teleost telencephalic eversion with tela choroidea covering dorsal telencephalon; does not locate or compare the paraphysis.
Chick SCO transcriptome as embryonic CSF source; no comparison with paraphysis in abstract.
Tubular retractor surgical series; origin sentence generic (third-ventricle neuroepithelial folding), no paraphysis or histogenesis data.
Teleost telencephalon spatial/single-cell atlas; no paraphysis/dorsal sac/velum coverage (full text checked by finder).
Zebrafish choroid plexus conservation and CSF homeostasis; generic ChP.
3D MRI atlas of Protopterus; full text never mentions paraphysis or dorsal sac.
LMX1A in hESC ventral midbrain differentiation; roof-plate fates in vitro, no telencephalic roof/paraphysis.
First-trimester sonographic cavum veli interpositi prevalence; imaging, does not bear on the paraphysis.
Radiation effects on organoid choroid plexus/hem markers; no paraphysis.
Anterior transcallosal colloid cyst series with CK/S100/PAX7 immunohistochemistry; authors state PAX-7 staining points to a paraphysis remnant (argues for paraphyseal origin).
Autopsy series of sudden death from colloid cysts; no origin analysis beyond 'congenital neuroepithelial'.
Operative case of hemorrhagic colloid cyst; repeats endodermal origin, no paraphysis or histogenesis data.
SOX2/LMX1A in hindbrain choroid plexus tumours and rhombic lip; no paraphysis.

Neurosurgical monograph chapter on developmental origins of the ventricular system and colloid cysts; snippets state origin from diencephalic recesses or paraphysis cerebri remnants and reconcile with endodermal trapping (chapter text not read).
MRI lifespan charts of lateral-ventricle choroid plexus; no third-ventricle roof or paraphysis data.
Pax6/Pax7 genoarchitecture in cladistian fishes; full abstract reports no Pax7 in telencephalon and never names paraphysis.
